name: GPU Monitor
author: David JM
description: Live view of the AMD graphics card straight from sysfs: utilization, clocks, temperatures, power draw, fan speed and VRAM usage. One shared service owns a single helper process that feeds every bar surface.

barWidget.description: A monitor glyph showing GPU utilization and junction temperature, refreshed every second from the amdgpu sysfs tree. Left-click opens a panel with clocks, VRAM, power, fan and per-sensor temperatures. Read-only and unprivileged — no helpers, no elevation.

schema.label: Hot temperature
schema.description: Turn the readout red when the GPU junction temperature reaches or exceeds this (°C).
